column3: The Hebrew repeats David’s name, calls the building his “house”, and describes the ark as being under curtains.
Egypt is not explicitly named. The final phrase says “and from a dwelling”, without repeating a destination.
The leaders are specifically called judges.
The Hebrew says “in My house and in My kingdom”, rather than “over”.
The Hebrew separately repeats “according to all these words” and “according to all this vision”.
The Hebrew says “do as You have spoken”.
The Hebrew describes God as God “for Israel”.
Revealing is pictured as uncovering the servant’s ear. Courage is not explicitly named.
The Hebrew says He spoke this goodness concerning His servant.
